instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Work out the next DNS request that pointing one of my hostnames at a new address needs, at a DNS provider my engine reaches for me, so a workflow sends it", and give it cutover (prepare, activate, rollback or status); dns (a DNS provider description with transport "engine"); hostname; address; receipt (for activate, rollback and status: the receipt an earlier answer gave); transcript ([] the first time).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:step-a-hostname-cut-over-through-the-engine and that input (the worked example shows one).

3. When it answers done false (more true), ask next.name of the description's server through the engine (tools:run with the description's base as address and <host>/<next.name> as tool, next.arguments as input), then step again with the same input, transcript set to the answer's transcript and add set to { request: next, answer: what the engine answered }.
4. When it answers done true, answer is the cut-over's own answer: keep its receipt for the next cut-over (activate after prepare, rollback after activate).
